settings.howto_content:
1. Name your club — tell us what your community is called. That name goes on every patch your members receive.
  2. We build your page — our team designs a custom embroidered patch for your club and gives it its own membership page on our store.
  3. Your people join — share the link. Your members subscribe on your page and get your patch every month.
settings.faq_content:
Do I get member benefits too?
Yes. Founding a club includes a full membership — 10% off store wide, exclusive drops, monthly workouts and a patch every month — plus the club perks on top.

Who designs the patch?
We do. Send us your club name and any logo or colors, and our team designs the patch and sends it for approval before anything is produced.

What does it cost my members?
The same as any Ruck On membership. They subscribe on your club's own page and get your patch instead of the Ruck On Club patch.

How do my members find my club?
You send them the link. Your club gets its own membership page on our store — share it in the gym, in your group chat, wherever your people are.

Is there a minimum number of members?
No. Start with one and grow from there.

Can I cancel?
Yes — no contracts. Manage or cancel anytime from your account.
